annotations.title: Brazil A2A Intent Protocol & Machine Contract Oracle

description: Issues and verifies cryptographically signed Machine-to-Machine (A2A) Economic Intent Protocols with ES256 (ECDSA P-256) digital signatures (RFC 7515) and canonical SHA-256 digests (RFC 8785). Enables autonomous enterprise agents (fleet management bots, hospital procurement systems, wholesale supply coordinators) to formalize procurement intent parameters with official ANP/CMED/SEFAZ regulatory benchmarks. Verifiable via https://mestrepratico.com.br/.well-known/jwks.json and /api/a2a/verify. Includes automated sandbox evaluation mode for test agents. When to use: When autonomous agents need to negotiate and document formal procurement intent parameters with verifiable cryptographic provenance. When NOT to use: For simple read-only price checks (use brazil_fuel_prices, brazil_grocery_basket, or brazil_pharma_medicines).

action.description: Action to perform: 'issue_intent' to generate a signed intent protocol, or 'verify_intent' to validate an existing protocol ID or hash. Defaults to 'issue_intent'.

agente_solicitante_id.description: Unique identifier of the requesting partner AI agent or automated bot (identifers containing TEST/AUDIT trigger sandbox mode). Defaults to 'FleetBot-Logistica-01'.

cidade.description: Target Brazilian municipality or distribution hub (e.g., 'Cabo Frio', 'Sao Paulo', 'Recife', 'Rio de Janeiro'). Defaults to 'Cabo Frio'.

contraparte_id.description: Identifier or role of the intended commercial partner or counterparty network. Optional.

item_especifico.description: Specific commodity code, fuel type (e.g., 'diesel_s10', 'gasolina'), or active pharmaceutical ingredient (e.g., 'losartana'). Defaults to 'diesel_s10'.

protocolo_id.description: Existing A2A protocol ID or SHA-256 hash to verify (required when action is 'verify_intent').

tipo_operacao.description: Economic procurement category for the machine intent contract: 'abastecimento_frota' (fleet refueling), 'cesta_basica_atacado' (wholesale food baskets), 'dispensacao_farmaceutica' (pharmaceutical supply), 'auditoria_tributaria' (tax audit certification). Defaults to 'abastecimento_frota'.

uf.description: Two-letter Brazilian state code where procurement will take place (e.g., 'rj', 'sp', 'mg', 'ba', 'pe'). Defaults to 'rj'.

volume_estimado.description: Estimated procurement volume in liters (for fuels), units (for food baskets), or packages (for medicines). Defaults to 500.

name: brazil_contract_intent_a2a
